opentargets.name: IL10-related early-onset inflammatory bowel disease
opentargets.description: A rare immune dysregulation disease with immunodeficiency characterized by severe, progressive infantile onset inflammatory bowel disease with pancolitis, perianal disease (ulceration, fistulae), recurrent respiratory, genitourinary and cutaneous infections, arthritis and a high risk of B-cell lymphoma.

opentargets.name: inflammatory bowel disease 25
opentargets.description: Any inflammatory bowel disease in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the IL10RB gene.
